purpose: Test whether suffix-level decisions can avoid a downstream deadline violation caused by a direct-scope greedy owner choice.
calibration_rule: Run both methods with loose deadlines. For each fixed geometry, require CDS-MR B3 completion step < Simple-local B3 completion step. Set the final B3 deadline step to floor((CDS step + Simple-local step)/2). Geometry, candidate sets, failure state, and algorithms remain unchanged.
primary_success_criterion: For at least the route case and its mirror: same paired failure state; Simple-local selects U2 and fails only the B3 deadline check or terminal execution because of that deadline; CDS-MR selects U3, completes the task, and passes all six contract checks.
secondary_success_criterion: The branch case shows the same outcome separation.
anti_claims: not evidence that CDS-MR explicitly optimizes deadlines
not evidence of lower NPSD in general
